about: Lists of local providers for Logan, Utah and Cache County (North Logan, Smithfield, Hyrum, Providence), found 6 October 2026 under brief-lists-only-20261006. Lists only: no provider names recorded as resources, no office-fit rules, no provider pages checked. Statewide Utah lists (211 Utah DHHS directory pages, Utah Legal Services, DLD, vitalrecords, jobs.utah.gov fee waiver, Commerce telecom assistance, veterans.utah.gov, mihp maternal guide, utcourts legal clinics, Lifeline) are already in ogden.json (statewide, see ogden.json) and are not repeated here.

gaps.addiction: Fair. Two current lists: the Utah Maternal and Infant Health Program's Bear River substance use cards (31 January 2025, about 6 Cache entries with service icons) and the Cache County 211 list (about 5, several outside the county). The Bear River Health Department directory is from 2020-21. AA meetings are on a Google site that was not readable here (cachevalleyaa); NA on an aggregator, 3 meetings. No Logan page on 211's own site was reachable for addiction.
gaps.children-pregnancy: Fair. The 211 Cache County list is current (about 25 entries across child/youth/family and pregnancy) and the USU basic-needs page names childcare. Nothing found for Logan diapers or baby supplies beyond news items and a statewide diaper programme; no list for older children or teens.
gaps.clothing-household: Thin. Only the 211 Cache County list (about 3 entries) and the county attorney's page (Basic Necessities, 5 entries, mostly food). No clothing-specific list for Logan; the aggregators found nothing.
gaps.disability: Thin and stale. The only dedicated list is the Utah Parent Center Cache County list (January 2018, children and families). BRAG's disability page just says to call Central Intake. 211's list has about 4 scattered entries. The 2022 USU assessment surveyed 18 aging and disability organisations but is a report, not a directory.
gaps.domestic-violence: Fair for a small town, but every list names the same few providers: CAPSA, victim services, SAAVI at USU, The Family Place. The 211 list has about 10 entries. The state victims-of-crime directory page (uovc.concerncenter.utah.gov) refused (403).
gaps.education: Thin. Bridgerland Tech's community list (4 entries), the refugee provider page, the state adult-education directory in ogden.json (statewide). No Cache-specific adult education/GED/ESL list found; the school district and Bridgerland Literacy pages describe single programmes.
gaps.employment: Thin. The 211 list (about 8 entries) and Bridgerland Tech's list (4). BRAG's STEPS and benefit navigator pages are programme pages. No Logan job-seeker or felony-friendly list found; the Church felon-resources PDF has no Logan entries.
gaps.financial-assistance: Fair. 211 Cache list (about 9), BRAG pages, USU basic-needs page. The aggregator page for Cache County assistance (needhelppayingbills) refused (403), so it was not read.
gaps.reentry-support: None of its own. No Cache County reentry list exists. The Cache County Criminal Justice Coordinating Council discussed a reentry resource map in 2025, but none was found. 211 has a single Adult Probation and Parole Logan page. The Church felon-resources page and ogden.json's statewide lists have no Logan entries. Cache County has a sheriff's probation unit page that lists no providers.
gaps.food: Good. Cache County 211 list (7), county attorney page, USU basic-needs page (6), Plentiful (3), Feeding America 211 (8, record dated 21 April 2026), Church ICP PDF (1; February 2024), 2022 USU food assessment (10). Nearly every list names the Cache Community Food Pantry first, so independence is limited.
gaps.medical-dental-vision: Fair. 211 Cache list (about 10), FreeClinics.us (10), county attorney page (4), USU basic needs (6). Bear River Health Department dental clinic and the community health centres appear on provider pages only. No vision-specific list found.
gaps.homeless-services: Thin, and the main finding: no year-round shelter in Cache County. The 211 Cache list names only Ogden providers. The Homeless Shelter Directory has nothing in Logan (stale, April 2020). The warming centre's own site (wabwarmingcenter.org) lists no partners. BRAG's homeless page is a programme page. The best list is the 2022 USU homelessness and housing assessment (17 agencies). The Bear River Local Homeless Council was found in news only, with no meeting or resource page.
gaps.housing: Fair. Affordable Housing Hub (17 properties) and Affordable Housing Online (15), BRAG pages, 211 list (about 4). No official county or city affordable-housing list; Logan City's housing authority was found only in search snippets, not on a readable list.
gaps.id-recovery: Thin. Only single-provider 211 pages (Logan driver licence office, Bear River Health Department birth certificates) plus statewide pages in ogden.json. No list for Cache.
gaps.immigration: Thin. The Utah refugee providers page names 3 Cache providers; the 211 list's ethnic/cultural block is mostly Ogden and Salt Lake; the Multicultural Center of Cache Valley closed (news). No local immigration legal-help list found. The 2022 assessment surveyed 15 organisations on inclusivity.
gaps.legal: Fair. 211 Cache list (about 6), Bridgerland Tech (4), BRAG Community Justice Advocates (debt, eviction), plus the Thursday Night Bar and pro se clinics known from search snippets but not from a list page. Statewide clinic lists are in ogden.json.
gaps.mental-health: Good. Bear River Health Department mental health directory for Box Elder, Cache and Rich (December 2021 and July 2020 editions; the largest, but stale), 211 list (about 7 plus crisis lines), Bridgerland Tech (16), county attorney (9). The 2022 USU assessment counted 57 organisations, mostly private practice, none in a current directory. The health department is renaming itself Bear River Behavioral Health (news), so URLs may move.
gaps.seniors: Good. Bear River Area Agency on Aging's own site, BRAG's Cache page, the Hyrum senior page (about 5 centres), 211 list (about 5), 2022 USU assessment (18 organisations).
gaps.transportation: Fair. 211 Cache list (about 6), 211 mobility voucher page, BRAG Bear River Mobility voucher programme, and Cache Valley Transit District pages. There is no single Logan transportation list; transit is zero-fare so most need is paratransit and out-of-town medical trips.
gaps.utilities-phone-internet: Fair. 211 Cache list names about 8 utilities including HEAT and Lifeline; BRAG's page names the HEAT contacts. Statewide Lifeline and Commerce lists are in ogden.json.
gaps.veterans: Thin. Warrior's Fund (4 listings), a BRAG veterans page, the Dan Gyllenskog Veterans Resource Center in North Logan (found in news, no list page), the 211 list (2 transport entries). The state veterans office page in ogden.json is statewide. No county veterans list found.
